text: ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti . evaṃ puṭṭhā tumeha bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyāthāti . [29] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca brahmacariyaṃ brahmacariyanti bhante vuccati . katamaṃ nu kho bhante brahmacariyaṃ . katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti . [30] ayameva kho bhikkhu ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ . seyyathīdaṃ . sammādiṭṭhi .pe. sammāsamādhi . yo kho bhikkhu rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo
